spec_grader.about: Frozen copies of the lint and the checker, not the skill's own scripts (skill-iterate rule 5). answer-units.json is frozen (step 6).

metrics.name: integrity
metrics.about: no failure of a script that ships with the skill (a runner's own helper scripts do not count), the skill's checker ended at 0 errors, no question to the user

metrics.name: lint_errors
metrics.about: errors from the frozen lint (new-format/grader/lint.py) on the final spec: missing files or fields, ids that repeat or do not resolve, a rule resting on nothing, a scenario citing no rule, broken links

metrics.name: checker_selftest
metrics.about: the frozen checker runs the trial's model.py and the model's deliberately broken SELFTEST rule yields a break

metrics.name: unlisted_breaks
metrics.about: breaks the frozen checker finds that policy.md does not list (rule id and reason must match)

metrics.name: listed_breaks
metrics.about: breaks listed on policy.md; each one is an owner decision

metrics.name: one_path_share
metrics.about: model-path scenarios that replay to exactly one path / model-path scenarios; gated against the build2 baseline

metrics.name: uncovered_steps
metrics.about: steps the frozen checker finds reachable (chart state and step label) that no scenario's path takes; reported, not gated

metrics.name: quote_valid
metrics.about: claims rows sourced "owner's words" whose quote is in the sources verbatim (after lower-casing and collapsing whitespace) / such rows

metrics.name: unsourced_claims
metrics.about: claims rows sourced "nobody" or "spec only"

metrics.name: answer_reach
metrics.about: recorded answer units (answer-units.json) that some claims row quotes / units; gated against the build2 baseline

metrics.name: guard_recommend
metrics.about: questions in interview-log.json with a recommended answer / questions asked

metrics.name: guard_none_limits
metrics.about: claims rows of kind limit with 'what ends it' filled / limit rows (1.0 when there are none)

metrics.name: guard_money
metrics.about: claims rows of kind money with the mismatch column filled / money rows (1.0 when there are none)

metrics.name: guard_systems
metrics.about: systems (Systems rows, and systems named by system claims) whose Systems row has owner and docs filled / systems

metrics.name: key_recall
metrics.about: key items (new-format/key-build2.md) the final spec avoids or puts to the owner as a decision / 9; judge applies new-format/judge-brief-key.md; reported, not gated (owner ruling 3)

metrics.name: owner_lines
metrics.about: non-blank lines of index.md, claims.md, rules.md and policy.md; gated against growth

metrics.name: chart_arrows
metrics.about: arrows in chart.mmd, not counting the start arrow; DECISIONS asks for about 20

metrics.name: stand_in_defaults
metrics.about: questions the stand-in answered by accepting the recommendation / questions asked

metrics.name: questions_asked
metrics.about: entries in interview-log.json (SWITCH-PLAN.md ruling 3)

metrics.name: owner_flags
metrics.about: distinct claims the skill's decision filter put to the owner, from the closing mark 'Claims put to the owner: C-..' of each question in interview-log.json; the owner's limit is 10 (SWITCH-PLAN.md ruling 3)

metrics.name: input_coverage
metrics.about: share of build-key.md items (interview answers, known failure cases, confirmed tool outcomes) the final spec asserts as the item says; gated against the build baseline

metrics.name: unsupported_statements
metrics.about: distinct product facts in the final spec that the inputs neither state nor imply, or contradict; gated against the build baseline

metrics.name: golden_distance
metrics.about: 1 - difflib ratio over whitespace-normalised non-blank lines of agent-spec-final.md vs the golden example spec; 0 = identical, round0 vs golden = 0.39

metrics.name: recall_key
metrics.about: share of key Important defects reported by a KEPT finding (same block, same defect); gated against the baseline only

metrics.name: recall_found
metrics.about: share of key defects ANY finder reported, kept or dropped; the gap to recall_key is what the verifiers threw away

metrics.name: false_positives
metrics.about: kept findings the judge rules Not real or Style only after reading spec and inputs; gated against the baseline only

metrics.name: fp_important
metrics.about: false positives among kept Important findings

metrics.name: fp_nit
metrics.about: false positives among kept Nit findings

metrics.name: dropped_real
metrics.about: dropped findings a blind judge (finding + spec + inputs only, no refutation) rules Real: defects the verifier threw away. Reported, not gated (2026-11-14): judge calibrated at n=6 only; a change that moves only this metric is inconclusive and defaults to revert

metrics.name: wall_clock_s
metrics.about: step 1 start to step 5 end (build2, build); first round start to last round end (full, round2)

metrics.name: finder_tool_calls_max
metrics.about: max tool_uses over non-Codex finders

metrics.name: tokens_total_k
metrics.about: sum of subagent tokens / 1000 (for a Codex subagent, its wrapper's tokens only)

metrics.name: cost_usd
metrics.about: USD from grading.json model_rates: tokens_in/out/cache_read x per-kind rates when the row has them, else tokens x blended; cross-model ratios are right either way, absolute dollars only with the split

metrics.name: verifier_drop_rate
metrics.about: dropped / (kept + dropped)

metrics.name: effort
metrics.about: the session's effort level the trial ran at; a trial whose effort differs from its baseline's fails the gate

notes: baseline-1's findings ARE the key, so its recall is circular and excluded from the recall baselines. Both judge metrics are gated relative to the baseline only; absolute bounds return once three baseline trials per kind exist. script_errors counts only the skill's own scripts (decided 2026-11-09). Baseline rolled to it1b-1..3 on 2026-11-09 (E5 merged); e4-base-1..3 and full-new-3 are history. Baseline rolled to it2-1..3 on 2026-11-10 (E6 merged). fp_verified/fp_unverified retired: every finding is verified from E6 on. dropped_real gated from 2026-11-10 (baseline worst 1). cost_usd added, report-only, with placeholder model rates. baseline-1 excluded from all judge metrics from 2026-11-11 (it is the pre-E5 original run, kept for cost only). round2 kind retired. M13 removed from the key 2026-11-11; key is 6 items. Baseline rolled to it4-1..3 + it4b-1..3 on 2026-11-11 (E8 merged; six samples). Blended rates re-derived from it4b-3's token split. build kind added 2026-11-11: its metrics are integrity, input_coverage, unsupported_statements, golden_distance, wall_clock_s (step 1 start to step 5 end), tokens_total_k, cost_usd, effort; metrics carrying "kinds" apply only to those kinds. build-key.md is a PROPOSAL. build2 kind moved here from grading-new.json on 2026-11-15 (task 028) and made the default_kind, with baseline switch-base-10..12; full and build retired the same day. Metrics carrying "kinds": ["build2"] came from grading-new.json, which was removed the same day once the grader tests read this file. judge_context.inputs gained owner-brief.md for build2's key_recall judge; grade.py has no per-kind inputs, so a re-judge of a retired build trial (input_coverage, unsupported_statements) would now be handed owner-brief.md, which its judges never had. Accepted trade-off (task 028): build ships no new trials and its verdicts exist, so a re-judge happens only on request (escalation case 4); dropping owner-brief.md instead would make new build2 key_recall tasks differ from the baseline's.

model_rates._about: USD per million tokens. in/out/cache_read are used when a subagent row carries tokens_in/tokens_out/tokens_cache_read; blended is used when it carries only tokens. blended = in x 1.96, measured on it4b-3 (2026-11-11): output 19 % of counted tokens, cache reads 4.9x the counted tokens. Re-measure when the brief or roles change.
